_comment: RealTargets text, English. Translate the values into <code>.json (EFT's language code: ru, ge, fr...); keep the keys, the {slots} and the <tags>. Keys ending .one/.few/.many/.other are plural forms.
autopsy.armour.heading: ARMOUR
autopsy.blast.note: EFT's own blast damage (no wound channel); its fragments are listed as their own row.
autopsy.cause.spread: the destroyed {part}'s damage spread to the {to}
autopsy.channel.cavity: temporary cavity up to {cm} cm across, widest
autopsy.channel.stretches: in {n} stretches (out of one part, into the next)
autopsy.gore.heading: GORE
autopsy.legend.2d: dot = entry, ring = exit, small ring = stopped by armour, red ring = fatal; yellow = your shots, blue = others. Hover a shot to trace it, click it for the details.
autopsy.legend.3d: Pose at the moment of death. Ball = entry, clear ball = exit, small ball = stopped by armour, red = fatal; yellow = your shots, blue = others. Bones (orange = fractured); organ zones (approximate) light up where a shot went through. Glowing spindle = temporary cavity: the tissue the round's energy stretched, widest where it dumped the most. Drag to turn, right-drag to move up/down, wheel to zoom, double-click to reset; hover a shot to trace it, click it to look at it and see the details.
autopsy.none.text: RealTargets saw no projectile hit this body this raid (it died before the mod was watching, or from something that isn't a projectile).
autopsy.none.title: No recorded wounds
autopsy.shots.heading: SHOTS
config.Autopsy.3D drag turns the camera: Off: dragging turns the body with the mouse (left button) and right-drag slides it up/down with the mouse. On: both move the camera instead (the opposite directions).
config.Autopsy.3D energy cavities: Glowing spindle along each wound channel: the temporary cavity, wider where the round dumped more energy.
config.Autopsy.3D organ zones: Approximate organ zones inside the 3D body; the ones a shot went through light up.
config.Autopsy.3D skeleton: Simplified skeleton inside the 3D body (orange = fractured at death).
config.Autopsy.Enabled: AUTOPSY tab next to LOOT when you loot a body: every shot that hit it (shooter, weapon, ammo, distance, armour, damage, path through the body), the killing shot, health at death and a front/back body chart.
config.Autopsy.Only my shots: List and draw only your own shots (bot-vs-bot hits on the same body are hidden).
config.Bleeding.Agonal pumping (s): After death the heart gives a few last, weakening beats: spurts and flow fade out over this long before only gravity drains the wounds. 0 = stops at once.
config.Bleeding.Arterial chance: Scales the chance that a hit where a big artery runs (neck, groin, thigh, upper arm; smaller ones in forearm, calf, face) cuts it and spurts. Base: neck 55 %, thigh 22 %, groin 20 %, upper arm 15 %, x energy (a pistol round about half as likely as a rifle round).
config.Bleeding.Bleed rate multiplier: Scales how fast every wound bleeds (2 = twice as fast). Visual only.
config.Bleeding.Blood volume (ml): Blood in a body. At most ~65 % of it can run out (pools stop growing there).
config.Bleeding.Post-mortem drain half-l: After death, open wounds keep draining by gravity (more if facing down), tapering with this half-life. 0 = bleeding stops at death.
config.Blood and wounds.Arterial spurts: Pulsing droplet jets from cut arteries at heart rate, weakening after death.
config.Blood and wounds.Blood mist: A short-lived cloud of fine blood at exit wounds (bigger with energy).
config.Blood and wounds.Blood running do: Bleeding wounds stain the clothing below them, further down as more blood runs out.
config.Blood and wounds.Bloody footprint: Anyone who walks through a wet pool (you or a bot) leaves boot prints after it, fainter with every step.
config.Blood and wounds.Drag smears: A bleeding corpse moved along the floor (dragged with TraumaCore or another mod, shoved by a blast) smears its blood behind the wound that touches the floor, fainter the further it goes.
config.Blood and wounds.Drips: Blood droplets welling and pouring from every open wound.
config.Blood and wounds.Enabled: All our blood and wound visuals.
config.Blood and wounds.Entry and exit w: Visible bullet wounds on the clothing/skin surface where each round went in and out (exit larger, ragged).
config.Blood and wounds.Exit spray: Droplets thrown out of the exit wound along the shot; they land as splats on whatever is behind.
config.Blood and wounds.Hide game blood: The game paints its own red blood splash into a bot's clothing texture on every hit (with HollywoodFX, its 'Wound Decals on Bodies' texture). Our wounds, soaks and runs already show the hit, so the splash only covers them. Turn off to keep the game's (or HollywoodFX's) splash. You and other human players always keep it.
config.Blood and wounds.Max distance (m): No blood visuals beyond this distance from the camera.
config.Blood and wounds.Mouth blood: Chest wounds: coughing blood while standing, dribbling from the mouth when lying or dead.
config.Blood and wounds.Pools: Blood pools spread under the wounds of dead (or prone) bodies, sized by the blood that ran out there, drying darker.
config.Blood and wounds.Wall spatter: A splash on the wall or floor behind a through-shot (within ~2.5 m), placed at once.
config.Blood look.Blood brightness on bo: Scales wounds and blood stains on bodies (live). Lower if blood on clothing looks like bright paint under a torch or in the sun.
config.Blood look.Blood brightness on th: Scales pools, drops, splats, prints and smears (live).
Scales ground blood while 'Ground blood shader' is EftWet or EftMatte (live).
config.Blood look.Decal shader: How wounds and ground blood are drawn. Lit: darken pass + a colour pass with a real lit shader (the map's lights and exposure decide the brightness, wet sheen). Hybrid (0.10.2): the colour pass is unlit, scaled by our own light estimate (glowed in dark rooms). Multiply: darken/tint only (invisible on black cloth). AlphaBlended: unlit colour pass only. Switches live (stumps and gibs follow Lit only at the start of a raid).
config.Blood look.Gore brightness (stump: Scales cut surfaces, gibs and the skull crater (live).
config.Blood look.Ground blood shader: What pools, drops, splats, prints and drag smears are drawn with (Decal shader = Lit; live). EftMatte (default): the game's own alpha-tested shader, lit like the map around it. Stock: Unity's legacy shader as in 1.1.0, tamed by 'Blood brightness on the ground'. EftWet: experimental, the game's specular shader; still renders white in shade.
config.Blood look.Ground blood wetness (: Scales the sheen and reflection of ground blood with 'Ground blood shader' EftWet (live). Lower if pools look like chrome, higher if they look dry.
config.Compatibility.HollywoodFX: prefer: Only when HollywoodFX is installed; switches live. Off: both mods' blood. Overlaps: ours skips what HollywoodFX already draws at the hit: the mist at the entry (backspatter) while its gore effects are on, and the splash on the wall behind while its blood splatter is on. All: also our exit spray, exit mist and the squeeze of blood from a shot corpse, so only HollywoodFX's blood shows at the moment of the hit (it has none at the exit side). Always ours: wounds, bleeding, stains, pools, footprints, mouth blood and gore.
config.Death screen.Autopsy key: On the raid results after a death: switches the model spot between your wounded PMC and the AUTOPSY of your own death (X-ray in the death pose, every shot that hit you and who fired it, cause of death, health at death). The AUTOPSY button next to the model does the same.
config.Death screen.Report: Whose report shows over your PMC on the raid results after a death; switches live. RealTargets: our AUTOPSY switch (TraumaCore's hit markers and labels are hidden). TraumaCore: only TraumaCore's report, no AUTOPSY switch. Both: TraumaCore's markers on the model and our AUTOPSY switch. Without TraumaCore installed, RealTargets and Both are the same.
config.Death screen.Wounds on your PMC: After a death, your PMC on the raid results screen shows what hit you: entry and exit wounds, blood on the clothes, a destroyed head or lost limbs (the same rules as on bots).
config.Debug.Log blood: Write each bleed event (new site, death, treatment, drain end), gore event and corpse push to the BepInEx log.
config.Debug.Log hits: Write one line to the BepInEx log per projectile that hits a player or bot.
config.Debug.Log wound placement: One log line per wound patch: where it was placed (skinned / flat) or why not. For tests and bug reports.
config.Dismemberment.Any-calibre energy: Any projectile with this energy in the head destroys it (.338 LM ~6500 J; 7.62x51 ~2600 J does not).
config.Dismemberment.Blast range scale: Scales how close a grenade must be to take a head (~0.3 m) or limb (~0.3-0.5 m), for an RGD-5.
config.Dismemberment.Cumulative head ene: A dead body's head comes apart once the rounds that entered it add up to this much energy (and at least `Cumulative head hits`): 9x19 ~13 hits, 5.45 ~5, 5.56 ~4, 7.62x39 3. A shotgun shell counts as one hit.
config.Dismemberment.Cumulative head hit: Least number of rounds in the head before it can come apart from repeated hits.
config.Dismemberment.Dismemberment: Heads and limbs come apart on the killing shot or on a corpse (never on a living bot), with realistic thresholds below.
config.Dismemberment.Gibs: Flesh and skull pieces fly when a head or limb comes apart.
config.Dismemberment.Head pellets: Pellets of one shell that must enter the head to destroy it.
config.Dismemberment.Heavy-calibre limb: A 12.7 mm or larger rifle/MG round with this energy severs the limb it hits (shotguns, rifles and the .50 AE pistol never do). 12.7x55 PS12 ~1490 J, PS12B ~2900 J.
config.Dismemberment.Large-calibre energ: A single projectile of 12 mm or more (slug, 23 mm, 12.7 mm rifle/MG; not .50 AE pistol) with this energy in the head destroys it.
config.Dismemberment.Shotgun range (m): Buckshot destroys a head only within this distance (a tight pattern).
config.Dismemberment.Skull burst energy: A single bullet with this energy in the head (below the destruction rules) bursts the skull open at the exit (head stays on): 7.62x51 ~3300 J, 7.62x54R ~3700, .50 AE Hawk JSP ~2850 and 7.62x39 FMJ/SP ~2450 do; .366 FMJ ~2200 and 7.62x39 PS/BP (~2000-2100) only get the big exit. Kills and corpses only.
config.Flinch.Enabled: Living bots flinch per limb via EFT's IK hit reaction (off by default: looks like a shake on top of the animation).
config.Flinch.Full IK hold (s): How long the bot's full-body IK stays in full-quality mode after a hit (EFT uses 0.6).
config.Flinch.Maximum: Largest flinch force (caps .50 cal / shotgun point blank).
config.Flinch.Minimum: Smallest flinch force for any hit that gets through.
config.Flinch.Strength: Global multiplier on the flinch force (EFT's own reaction = 1).
config.General.Enabled: Master switch: off = no new blood, wounds, gore, corpse motion or footprints (what is already in the raid stays). For FPS comparisons and quick disabling.
config.General.Language: Language of RealTargets' own text (autopsy, death screen, these descriptions): Auto = the game's language; or a code from BepInEx/plugins/RealTargets/locales (ru, ge, fr...). English when that language has no file. Descriptions change after a restart.
config.Hit model (advanced).Armour stop: If less than this share of a hit's damage gets past armour/helmet, the round counts as stopped (no hole, no bleeding) instead of entering the body.
config.Hit model (advanced).Armour trans: Share of impact energy the body still feels when armour stops the round (0 = none, 1 = all).
config.Hit model (advanced).Cavity scale: Size of the temporary cavity around the bullet path: how big exit wounds get with energy.
config.Hit model (advanced).Heavy thresh: Effective energy from which a hit counts as HEAVY.
config.Hit model (advanced).Massive thre: Effective energy from which a hit counts as MASSIVE.
config.Hit model (advanced).Reference en: Effective impact energy that gives flinch strength x1 (about a 5.56 rifle round).
config.Hit model (advanced).Volley windo: Seconds to wait for the rest of a cartridge's hits before reacting, e.g. shotgun pellets that land a frame apart at range, or a bullet that crosses a plate and the body in different frames, so each cartridge reacts once.
config.Impacts.Blast injuries: Grenade blasts throw corpses within 6 m away from the charge (by overpressure). Damage to the living is EFT's.
config.Impacts.Enabled: Bullets push dead bodies (momentum at the hit bone).
config.Impacts.Push corpses: Shots move corpses (frozen corpses are woken for a few seconds, then settle again).
config.Impacts.Push strength: Multiplier on the bullet momentum given to a corpse (1 = physical momentum transfer; a round that exits passes on ~35 % of it).
part.Head: Head
